en.headline: Work-week outlook: very hot Monday then unsettled with showers and thunderstorms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects sunny periods and very hot conditions on Monday before a broad trough brings cloudier weather, showers and squally thunderstorms from midweek.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s nine-day forecast indicates that Monday will still be very hot with sunny periods and a few showers, with temperatures reaching around 33 degrees Celsius. Light winds are expected.

From Tuesday, a broad trough of low pressure will affect the northern South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong. Weather will become mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Winds will strengthen to east to northeast force 3 to 4, reaching force 5 offshore later.

Midweek onwards is expected to remain unsettled, with mainly cloudy skies, showers and occasional squally thunderstorms. Temperatures will ease slightly to the low 30s. The Observatory advises the public to stay alert to the latest weather warnings.

zh.headline: 下周天氣展望：周一酷熱後中期轉不穩定有驟雨雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台預料周一短暫陽光及酷熱，其後受廣闊低壓槽影響，中期起大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及雷暴，風力亦會加強。
body: 天文台九天天氣預報顯示，周一仍短暫時間有陽光及酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，有幾陣驟雨，吹微風。
周二起廣闊低壓槽影響南海北部至台灣以東海域，本港天氣轉為大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及雷暴。吹東至東北風3至4級，稍後離岸及高地達5級。
本周中期至周末天氣繼續不穩定，大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及狂風雷暴，氣溫稍降至低30度左右。市民請留意最新天氣警告。
